title: Hydrotherapy Intervention in Elderly With Knee Osteoarthritis
brief_summary: Knee osteoarthritis is a common condition characterized by pain and functional disability in older people. Prevalence increases with age and is more frequent in older women. The aim of this study was to assess the effects of an 8-weeks hydrotherapy training with elastic bands on pain and functional disability in old people with knee osteoarthritis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* confirmed clinical diagnosis of knee osteoarthritis

Exclusion Criteria:

* total knee arthroplasty
* inability to co-operate or follow instructions.
* a major neurological disorder
